sloka: नखदंष्ट्रायुधाः क्रूरा मनःसम्पातरंहसः ।युद्धोन्मत्ता बलोद्रिक्ताः शैला इव विसर्पिणः ।। ७.१६.१८ ॥
transliteration: nakhadaṁṣṭrāyudhāḥ krūrā manaḥsampātaraṁhasaḥ ।yuddhonmattā balodriktāḥ śailā iva visarpiṇaḥ ।। 7.16.18 ॥

translations.english: They will be fierce, with nails and fangs as their weapons, swift as thought, intoxicated with battle, overflowing with strength, and moving like mountains.
